description: This Java source file implements the RetrieveAttributesStrategy class, which handles RetrieveAttributes commands within the specific package context. It provides logic to extract attributes from a Thing object, generate JSON responses, and manage entity tags related to attribute retrieval.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the strategy to handle RetrieveAttributes commands, extending AbstractThingCommandStrategy with specialized logic for attribute retrieval.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the RetrieveAttributes command by extracting attributes from a Thing object and generating an appropriate Result, either with attribute data or with an error if attributes are not found.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Helper method to extract Attributes from a given Thing, throwing an exception if the entity is absent.

methods.name: getAttributesJson
methods.description: Converts Attributes to a JSON object, optionally selecting specific fields based on the command.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag applicable for the Command, based on the previous state of the Thing.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next entity tag from the new entity state (Thing).
